name: Layaway Jar
description: Save BCH toward a fixed target and release it to a merchant, or refund it to the saver.

saver.name: Saver
saver.description: The person saving toward the target. Holds the key that authorizes deposits, release and refund.

createJar.name: Create Layaway Jar
createJar.description: Start a jar with a target, a merchant, a unique jar id and an initial deposit.

saver.name: Create jar
saver.description: Choose the target, merchant and initial deposit.

deposit.name: Deposit
deposit.description: Add satoshis to the jar. The same jar covenant and jar id are carried forward with a larger balance.

release.name: Release to Merchant
release.description: Pay the merchant the target once the jar holds at least the target plus the miner fee and a dust refund.

refund.name: Refund to Saver
refund.description: Return the jar balance minus the miner fee to the saver and close the jar.

createJarTransaction.name: Layaway Jar Created
createJarTransaction.description: Created a layaway jar with $(<jarSatoshis>) satoshis toward a target of $(<targetSatoshis>) satoshis.

depositTransaction.name: Jar Deposit
depositTransaction.description: Added $(<depositedSatoshis>) satoshis to the jar, bringing it to $(<jarSatoshis> <depositedSatoshis> OP_ADD) satoshis.

releaseTransaction.name: Jar Released
releaseTransaction.description: Released $(<targetSatoshis>) satoshis to the merchant. The remaining jar balance returned to the saver.

refundTransaction.name: Jar Refunded
refundTransaction.description: Refunded the jar balance minus $(<feeSatoshis>) satoshis of miner fee to the saver.

jarInput.name: Jar balance
jarInput.description: The layaway jar covenant output holding $(<jarSatoshis>) satoshis.

initialJarOutput.name: Layaway Jar
initialJarOutput.description: A new jar holding $(<jarSatoshis>) satoshis toward a target of $(<targetSatoshis>) satoshis.

depositJarOutput.name: Layaway Jar
depositJarOutput.description: The jar carried forward with $(<jarSatoshis> <depositedSatoshis> OP_ADD) satoshis.

merchantOutput.name: Merchant payment
merchantOutput.description: The merchant receives the $(<targetSatoshis>) satoshi target.

releaseRefundOutput.name: Saver refund
releaseRefundOutput.description: The part of the jar above the target, after the miner fee, returns to the saver.

refundOutput.name: Saver refund
refundOutput.description: The jar balance minus the miner fee returns to the saver.

jarScript.name: Layaway Jar Covenant
jarScript.description: Holds the jar balance and enforces deposit, merchant release and saver refund.

scripts.enforceDeposit: OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_BIN2NUM OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_BIN2NUM OP_GREATERTHAN OP_VERIFY OP_1
scripts.enforceRelease: OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <targetSatoshis> OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <targetSatoshis> OP_NUMEQUAL OP_VERIFY OP_1
scripts.enforceRefund: OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE <saverLockingScript> OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_BIN2NUM OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <3000> OP_SUB OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY OP_1
scripts.enforceMerchantOrRefund: OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE <merchantLockingScript> OP_EQUAL OP_IF enforceRelease OP_ELSE enforceRefund OP_ENDIF
scripts.enforceJarRules: OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOBYTECODE OP_EQUAL OP_IF enforceDeposit OP_ELSE enforceMerchantOrRefund OP_ENDIF

minimumFeeSatoshis.name: Minimum miner fee
minimumFeeSatoshis.description: Documented minimum fee for release and refund actions. Applications should choose at least this value.

maxRefundFeeSatoshis.name: Maximum refund fee
maxRefundFeeSatoshis.description: On-chain cap on the fee a refund may take from the jar.

dustLimit.name: Dust limit
dustLimit.description: Minimum value of the saver refund/change output.

saverKey.name: Saver key
saverKey.description: The key that authorizes deposits, release and refund.

jarId.name: Jar id
jarId.description: A random 32-byte salt that makes this jar address unique.

jarSatoshis.name: Jar balance
jarSatoshis.description: The current number of satoshis held by the jar.

depositedSatoshis.name: Deposit amount
depositedSatoshis.description: The number of satoshis to add to the jar.

targetSatoshis.name: Target
targetSatoshis.description: The number of satoshis the jar must hold before it can be released to the merchant.

merchantLockingScript.name: Merchant
merchantLockingScript.description: The locking script that receives the target when the jar is released.

saverLockingScript.name: Saver destination
saverLockingScript.description: The locking script that receives refunds and any amount above the target.

feeSatoshis.name: Miner fee
feeSatoshis.description: The miner fee taken from the jar on release or refund. At least 2000 sats is recommended.

resources.name: Pre-kickoff prototype
resources.description: Public pre-kickoff repository and prototype disclosure.
